      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Whether returning a v0 PSBT should have a separate error message or whether the external signer must return the matching PSBT version.",

        "rc:4120178964"
      ],

      "status_by_id": "rc:4120178964",
      "status_by_quote": "I added a constraint that the version must match."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3957608379",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Add single-input test transactions for ECDSA and taproot so each FindUnsafeSighashType branch is exercised independently.",
      "quote": "A single-input transaction of each type would make each branch carry its own case. Worth adding?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added a test case",

      ],
